parts.text: Which product categories had the longest average shipping delay (shipped to delivered) in the last 90 days?

In the last 90 days, "Clothing Sets" had the longest average shipping delay of 3.1664 days. However, this is a low confidence finding, as it is based on only 9 rows of data.

The next longest average shipping delay was for "Dresses" at 2.5492 days. This is considered the top reliable finding based on the number of data points.

The following categories had the next longest shipping delays:
*   Intimates: 2.54 days
*   Socks: 2.5047 days
*   Sweaters: 2.4628 days

The differences between "Dresses" and "Pants" (the category with a 10.63% difference from "Dresses") are meaningful, while all other category-to-category differences are not meaningful. "Jumpsuits & Rompers" (2.2993 days) and "Suits" (2.2837 days) were also low confidence findings.

response.sql:
SELECT p.category AS name,
      ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(oi.delivered_at, oi.shipped_at, SECOND))/86400, 4) AS value,
      COUNT(*) AS row_count
    FROM `enterprise-agent-labs-1012.thelook_golden.order_items` oi
    JOIN `enterprise-agent-labs-1012.thelook_golden.products` p ON oi.product_id = p.id
    WHERE oi.shipped_at IS NOT NULL
      AND oi.delivered_at >= TIMESTAMP(@start) AND oi.delivered_at < TIMESTAMP(@end)
    GROUP BY name ORDER BY value DESC
